ok.description: A server-sent event stream: one frame per committed voucher state change matching the filter, comment lines as heartbeats. A frame carries the on-chain event id in an `id:` line and a JSON object with `id`, `type`, `voucherId`, `providerAddress`, `status`, `ledger`, `txHash` and `at` — the same facts the JSON routes expose for that transition, and never a beneficiary reference. Send the last `id:` back as `Last-Event-ID` to replay up to 500 later events in order before going live; if the cursor is too old, one `event: reset` frame says to refetch. The example shows a first connect, one frame and a heartbeat.
